<js>
var html=String(result);
var title=String(chapter.title);
var items=html.match(/data-src="([^"]*)"[^>]*data-subtitle="([^"]*)"/g);
if(!items){''}else{
  var found='';
  for(var i=0;i<items.length;i++){
    var m=items[i].match(/data-subtitle="([^"]*)"/);
    if(m&&m[1]==title){
      var s=items[i].match(/data-src="([^"]*)"/);
      if(s){found='https://www.yssm5.xyz'+s[1];break}
    }
  }
  if(!found){
    var s0=items[0].match(/data-src="([^"]*)"/);
    if(s0){found='https://www.yssm5.xyz'+s0[1]}
  }
  found;
}
</js>
